visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of the finished dish: golden-brown Thai shrimp piled high, garnished with a vibrant green scallion and garlic sauce, accompanied by lime slices on a white plate. (2) Hands wearing plastic gloves appear, placing several large, raw Thai shrimp into a clear glass bowl on a wooden tabletop; seasonings including white pepper and salt are added and hand-mixed. (3) The scene shifts to a black frying pan where oil is heated; minced garlic, red chili, and a large portion of chopped green scallions are added and stir-fried with a spatula until fragrant. (4) In a deep fryer or wok, the marinated shrimp are submerged in hot oil, creating significant white bubbling as they turn orange-red; the temperature is indicated by a text overlay. (5) The fried shrimp are then transferred to a dry wok with fresh garlic and chili; more powdered seasonings are sprinkled over them while being tossed rapidly. (6) A male chef in a white professional uniform is shown from the chest up, holding a wok and using a black handheld hairdryer to blow air directly onto the shrimp while tossing them. (7) The final phase shows the shrimp being plated with tongs onto a white dish, followed by a final drizzle of the previously prepared scallion sauce.
